---

## 4. Master Infrastructure, Lifestyle & On-Campus School
- **Podar International School**: Operational K-12 CBSE International School within the township perimeter. Children walk to school within the protected, vehicular-segregated township campus.
- **Olympic Sports Clubhouse**: ~1 Lakh Sq.Ft multi-tier lifestyle clubhouse with Olympic-sized lap pool, indoor heated pool, squash courts, badminton pavilion, TechnoGym fitness center, spa, and banquet halls.
- **Open Green Density**: 25+ acres of central civic gardens, Miyawaki organic forest trails, cycling paths, and outdoor amphitheatres.

---

## 5. Arterial Connectivity & Transit Distance
- **Magarpatta Cybercity**: ~6.0 km (10 Mins)
- **Kharadi EON IT Park & World Trade Center (WTC)**: ~7.5 km (14 Mins via Manjari-Kharadi Bridge)
- **SP Infocity Phursungi (IT SEZ)**: ~6.5 km (12 Mins)
- **Amanora Mall & Seasons Mall**: ~5.5 km (10 Mins)
- **Pune International Airport (Lohegaon)**: ~14.5 km (25 Mins)
- **Pune Central Railway Station**: ~12.0 km (24 Mins)
- **Upcoming PMRDA Ring Road**: Direct access interchange under development.
